title: A sprint subagent can run rag.py eval in its worktree
goal: A kb-worker or sprint subagent in an isolation worktree runs python3 _tools/rag.py eval without a guard refusing it; the story first names the guard that refused every command containing eval in SP-osxj4vmf (repo hook, plugin hook or harness), then either allows the command or documents the pytest wrapper as the sprint gate in kb/_self/backlog.md
notes: The same refusal recurred in SP-fkyrld5h: three workers (TK-yuqgx56h, TK-yg4pe6fv, TK-53y3nhli) could not run their rag.py eval check and ran tests.py -k test_lookup_eval_passes instead. A third way out, besides allowing the command or documenting the wrapper: a second name for rag.py's eval command without the word eval.
